name: The Codex
description: Book + audiobook metadata for Rewind — one search across Hardcover, Google Books, Open Library and Audible (Audnexus), merged: covers, authors, narrators, series, descriptions, chapters. Powers the Books space; The Forge finds the releases.

configKeys.label: Hardcover API token
configKeys.description: Optional, recommended. Best covers, series and ratings. hardcover.app → Settings → Hardcover API (expires every 1 January).

configKeys.label: Google Books API key
configKeys.description: Optional. Strong for German and other non-English books. Free key from Google Cloud Console → Books API.
